Why This Ceylon Cinnamon Formula Actually Works
Genuine Ceylon, Not Cassia

Each softgel contains Cinnamomum verum, the authentic Ceylon variety, harvested in Sri Lanka and concentrated 12:1 to equal 7,200 mg of raw cinnamon per dose. Unlike Cassia, it's naturally low in coumarin, which matters if you're 50+ and taking it daily for years, not just weeks.

7,200 mg Potency, One Softgel

Most cinnamon supplements underdose you, a few hundred milligrams of powder isn't enough to matter. One Metabolae softgel delivers a full therapeutic-level dose in a single serving, so you're not swallowing a handful of capsules or stirring powder into your coffee just to get a meaningful amount.

MCT-Powered Absorption

Cinnamon's active compounds are fat-soluble, which most people don't realize. Without a fat carrier, they largely pass through your digestive system unused, and that effect only gets worse as digestion slows with age. MCT oil solves this by carrying the extract directly into your bloodstream, where it can actually go to work.

Third-Party Lab Verified

Every batch is sent to an independent lab, not as a formality, but because you deserve to know exactly what you're putting in your body. Each batch is verified free of coumarin, GMOs, gluten, and artificial fillers, so there's nothing hidden in what you're taking every day.

Frequently Asked Questions
What makes Ceylon cinnamon different from what most supplements use?

Nearly all cinnamon supplements are made with Cassia and it matters more than most people realize. Cassia is high in coumarin, which builds up and can stress your liver with regular use. Ceylon from Sri Lanka has almost none, making it the right choice for daily, therapeutic-level supplementation. Our 12-to-1 concentration delivers 7,200mg equivalent of actual Ceylon per softgel, in a bioavailable form your body can put to use.

How does Metabolae compare to standard cinnamon capsules at the pharmacy?

What you'll find at the pharmacy is almost always low-dose Cassia in a basic capsule — minimal potency, minimal absorption. Metabolae uses a 12:1 Ceylon extract delivered in MCT oil. The difference in strength and bioavailability is significant: each softgel delivers the equivalent of 7,200mg of raw Ceylon bark in a form your body can genuinely absorb.

Is it safe to take alongside my current medications?

Most people tolerate Ceylon cinnamon well, but if you're currently managing blood sugar with medication or taking blood thinners, have a conversation with your doctor before you start. That's good practice with any new supplement and worth the phone call.

When can I expect to notice a difference?

Energy and balance improvements tend to show up first, usually within the first 2–4 weeks for people who take it consistently. Blood sugar support takes longer to become measurable; plan for at least 6–8 weeks before drawing conclusions. How quickly you notice a difference depends on your starting point, diet, and daily habits.
